data.name: Fish and Ships
data.detailed_description:
Choose your captain (based on their different skills), choose your boat and get ready to fight and survive. 

Gain experience while you are in battle, level up and choose carefully how to build your weapon arsenal, because that could be the difference between being the champion or... dying?

Play through the different stadiums while you build your audience. They are trusted supporters, and with their help, your fame will rise, and you will get to the final match. If you pass, you conquer the title, but get ready because that's only the beginning: multiple worlds with different enemies, bosses and biomes await you.

In order to help you in this journey, you'll be able to buy permanent upgrades and different fun skills that will make you stronger and more capable of conquering all the remaining worlds.

Good luck and safe travels!

data.short_description: Fish & Ships is a survivor-like game where you fight in an arena to demonstrate who the real league champion is. Fight against endless enemy waves in diverse stadiums, upgrade your ship and unlock fun skills that change the way you play in the arena.

English*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050 or similar
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 and Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
